registry.lookup: fingerprint-based open addressing with collision-safe exact-key verification

finding: A bounded 16384-entry run-lifetime registry removes the 32-entry MultiSWAP working-set limitation. Ten thousand unique hydraulic authorities can be built once and reused exactly, while capacity overflow remains correctness-safe through the F-AHL29 uncached fallback.
nonclaims: The registry qualification is synthetic and does not establish national MultiSWAP runtime.
Metadata and allocator overhead are additional to support-array payload.
No application speed claim follows from registry correctness alone.
next_action: Reconcile provider-local same-key memoization from F-AHL28B and then measure the combined lifecycle path rather than cache lookup in isolation.
